title: tiered-msadpa-exception-self-serve-and-pricing-simulation-playbook
creator: Avery Chen
description: Create a staged, tiered MSA/DPA exception workflow that enables sales to request bounded indemnity/liability concessions via a self-serve UI, runs a pricing impact simulation, and outputs a recommended approval lane. Deliverables: (1) playbook and scoring rules for auto-approve thresholds, (2) pricing simulation model to estimate revenue/legal risk impact, (3) UI copy and mock for the sales self-serve flow, (4) integration spec for Legal queue and telemetry to measure uptake and SLA. Goal: reduce manual legal triage for common, low-risk concessions and quantify downstream pricing effects so Product and Revenue can run experiments safely.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook with clear thresholds for auto-approve, sales-led approval, and legal-only review is published in Confluence
Pricing simulation runs against historical contract data and outputs expected ARR impact with 95% CI
Sales self-serve UI prototype with clear guardrails and audit trail implemented in design mock
Legal queue integration created (GitHub PR + routed webhook) and telemetry surfaces time-to-resolution and approval rates
Security review completed for data surfaced in UI and for any KMS/HSM interactions
comments: 2026-02-15 - Avery Chen: Kickoff — scoped approach with Legal, Sales Ops, and Revenue Strategy. Primary risk: underestimating indemnity exposure when multiple concessions stack. Initial ask: try 3-tier thresholds (auto, sales, legal).

2026-02-18 - Priya Kumar: Met with Legal (M. Santos, L. Becker). Legal proposed a clause fingerprinting approach to map redline categories to risk scores. Action: Legal to deliver sample clause-to-risk mapping by 2026-02-24.

2026-02-24 - Legal (M. Santos): Delivered initial mapping (link: https://confluence.redwood/contract-risk/mapping-v1). Notes: concentration on indemnity cap, carveouts for regulatory data, and escrow language. Flagged: combined indemnity + warranty exceptions increase tail risk non-linearly.

2026-02-26 - Data Science (S. Ortiz): Ran first-pass pricing simulation using 18 months of closed-won contracts (anonymized). Outcome: allowing indemnity cap > $5M without additional price yields 2.4% uplift in win rate but expected ARR exposure increase of 18%. Uploaded notebook: https://github.com/redwood/research/pricing-simulations/pull/62

2026-02-28 - Design (R. Nwosu): Uploaded self-serve mock and microcopy for guardrails (Drive link: https://drive.redwood/designs/msadpa-self-serve-v1). UX decision: show estimated price delta and legal risk band before submit. Need PM sign-off on wording.

2026-03-01 - Priya Kumar: Decision log — adopt 3-tier model with conservative auto-approve (indemnity cap <= $250k and no geo carveouts), sales-approve for mid tier with mandatory price uplift, and legal-only for high-risk combos. Trade-offs: tighter auto-approve reduces sales friction but limits PLG velocity. Next: engineer spec for routing and telemetry (ENG-22344).
